literal: Among those we have seen as truth, there is not anything whatsoever, good things other than truthfulness.
translation: Among all the things we have realized as true, there is nothing whatsoever that is better than truthfulness.
modern: நாம் உண்மையாக உணர்ந்தவற்றுள், வாய்மையை விடச் சிறந்த வேறு நல்ல பொருள்கள் சிறிதளவும் இல்லை.
explanation: The poet speaks from collective experience, stating that among all the things recognized as true or real, nothing surpasses truthfulness. The word வாய்மையின் uses the comparative suffix இன் to weigh truthfulness against all other virtues. Consequently, no other good thing, no matter how small, can be considered greater than being truthful.
